criteria.description: DNS backend and resolver interfaces expose BackendType, Health, ListRecords, SyncZone, Resolve, and Refs without per-record mutation methods.
Static resolver rejects duplicate backend refs and returns deterministic sorted refs.
Filesystem backend health verifies the configured root directory exists and is writable.
Filesystem backend returns an empty record set for missing zone files and round-trips full zone snapshots.
Filesystem SyncZone writes deterministic, idempotent JSON snapshots sorted by FQDN, record type, and value using atomic file replacement.
